name: Twinlife Jab
description: Jab with the user's own hand while a second hand of qi strikes from the shoulder.

name: Twinlife Shell
description: Raise a second self of qi in front of the body to take the first blow.

name: Twinlife Sense
description: Let the second self look ahead and warn the first of the foe's next move.

name: Twinlife Mend
description: Send the second self into an ally's wound to knit it from the inside.

name: Twinlife Step
description: Step with one self while the other holds the old place, then trade places.

name: Twinlife Purge
description: Pass an ally's taint into the second self and let it burn away outside the body.

name: Twinlife Cut
description: Cut through the guard with one hand and again with the second self in the same wound.

name: Twinlife Raise
description: Send the second self into the body of a newly fallen ally and restart the breath.

name: Twinlife Slip
description: Slip into the second self's place across the field, as if the two were never apart.

name: Bound Pulses
description: Bind the user and a fallen ally to one pulse until both rise together.

name: Ashen Spark
description: Flick a spark of ash-grey qi that settles on the target and burns slowly.

name: Sootfall Veil
description: Pull a veil of falling ash round the body that softens every blow.

name: Ashen Reading
description: Read the ash left on a body or a blade to learn what burned it.

name: Ashen Brand
description: Strike with a fist banked with embers that flare on contact.

name: Ashen Balm
description: Smear cool ash balm over an ally's burns and cuts and let it knit the skin.

name: Ashen Gust
description: Blow a gust of ash into the foe's eyes so their next stroke goes wide.

name: Ashen Wash
description: Wash an ally's blood through a fine ash that takes poison and taint with it.

name: Ashen Pyre
description: Raise a ring of ash-fire round the user that burns all who stand within it.

name: Ashen Rise
description: Raise a newly fallen ally out of the ash with a breath that restarts the heart.

name: Ashen Mantle
description: Drape a mantle of ash that burns away blows and returns their force as heat to the core.

name: Rebirth Pyre
description: Burn the core down to ash and rise from it, drawing the fallen up and scorching foes.

name: Spirit Tap
description: Tap the foe's chest with a finger of returning qi that jars the breath.

name: Spirit Casing
description: Hold a ward of spirit qi round the body that thickens as blows land on it.

name: Spirit Sight
description: See how firmly each nearby body holds its spirit and whom a blow might loosen.

name: Spirit Mend
description: Steady a wounded ally's spirit in the body and let the flesh follow it back.

name: Spirit Chain
description: Chain the foe's spirit to the spot with a link of qi that resists each pull.

name: Spirit Gust
description: Carry the body on a gust of spirit qi to the far side of the foe.

name: Spirit Call
description: Call a newly fallen ally's spirit back by name before it leaves the body.

name: Spirit Lance
description: Thrust a lance of returning qi through the guard and into the foe's centre.

name: Spirit Passage
description: Pass through the foe's line as a spirit does, leaving the body unharmed behind.

name: Returning Oath
description: Swear the fallen back to the body and seal the way so the spirit cannot stray again.

name: Endless Fist
description: Throw a fist that leaves a ring of qi to be struck again by the return stroke.

name: Endless Ring
description: Hold a ring of qi in front of the chest that turns without ceasing and wears blows down.

name: Endless Count
description: Count the turns of the foe's rhythm and predict the next one.

name: Endless Breath
description: Pass a breath round a ring of qi from the user to an ally and back to restore both.

name: Endless Mend
description: Turn a ring of mending qi through an ally's body without a break until wounds close.

name: Endless Turn
description: Turn round the foe on a ring of steps that never leaves the circle.

name: Endless Flush
description: Flush the blood of an ally with a constant ring of clean qi until taint is gone.

name: Endless Snare
description: Wind a ring of qi round the foe that tightens each time the foe turns.

name: Endless Raise
description: Turn the wheel back over a newly fallen ally until the breath returns.

name: Endless Roll
description: Roll a great ring of qi over the foes that crushes all caught in its turn.

name: Endless Sink
description: Sink every blow into the turning wheel of the core and hold the force in store.

name: Endless Wheel
description: Spin the core's great wheel to sweep all foes and mend all allies in one turn.
